snippet.title: Ascend to ZERO | Official Open Playtest Announcement
snippet.description:
Join Ascend to ZERO's FIRST OFFICAL OPEN PLAYTEST now!  
We’re opening the gates for everyone to jump in, break things, and tell us what you think. 

🎮 Join the playtest on Steam: https://bit.ly/AscendtoZERO_Playtest
✨ Join the Discord here: https://discord.com/invite/NjBVgEEBpv
